title: Listening Band And Section Profiles
description: Introduce a listening generation profile that maps difficulty/Band and Section into prompt constraints, quiz count, dialogue style, section-specific task design, and fallback behavior.

success: Band 5.0, 6.0, and 7.0 produce distinguishable constraints for sentence length, vocabulary, paraphrase, and distractor density.
Section 1/2/3/4 profiles are explicit and testable.
verification: Manual or scripted generation of at least one sample per Section
